Application for Hardship Waiver 
Submission of this Application for Hardship Waiver (Application) and documentation is necessary 
to apply for a waiver of the applicant’s proportionate share of the estate claim. An applicant has 
60 days from the date stated on the Department of Health Care Services’ (Department/DHCS) 
notice of claim to submit an Application. All of the information requested in the Application is 
voluntary; however, failure to provide accurate documentation to substantiate hardship may result 
in a denial of the Application. A signature is required to process an Application. It is not necessary 
for the applicant to submit documentation previously received by the Department. The 
Department reserves the right to request additional documentation. 
A substantial hardship shall not exist when the decedent or applicant created the hardship by 
using estate planning methods to divert or shelter assets in order to avoid estate recovery. 
Please mail completed forms to: 
Department of Health Care Services 
Estate Recovery Section 
P.O. Box 997425, MS 4720 
Sacramento, CA 95899-7425 
For questions on the form, please call the collection representative assigned to your case or the 
Estate Recovery mainline at 916-650-0490. 
Si prefiere acceso a esta forma en Español, por favor visite nuestra pagina de web 
http://www.dhcs.ca.gov/services/Pages/SubstantialHardshipCriteria.aspx o puede contactar a su 
representante de colección para solicitar una copia. 
All applicants must complete Sections A, B, C and G. Applicants must also submit requested 
documentation and complete other sections, as specified in Section C.

困難回避申請
この困難解消申請書（以下「申請書」）および関連書類の提出は、申請者の遺産請求における比例配
分額の制限を申請するために必要です。
申請者は、保健医療サービス局（以下「局/DHCS」）の請求通知書に記載された日付から60日以内に
申請書を提出する必要があります。申請書に記載された情報はすべて任意ですが、困難を証明する正
確な書類を行わない場合、申請が却下される可能性があります。 申請書処理には個別が必要です。
申請者は、すでに局に提出済みの書類を要求する必要はありません。
故人または申請者が、遺産回収を回避するために資産を流用または隠蔽する目的で遺産計画手法を用いて困難を生じさせ
た場合、重大な困難は存在しないものとする。
